requirement.description: The async_option builder is incorrectly trying to call 'send' method on async_generator objects, which don't have this method. This leads to AttributeError: 'async_generator' object has no attribute 'send'.
requirement.contract: The async_option builder must properly handle async generators without attempting to call send() method directly on them. It should correctly iterate through the async generator to extract values and handle control flow appropriately.

requirement.description: The async_result builder has the same issue as async_option - it's trying to call 'send' on async_generator objects that don't support this method.
requirement.contract: The async_result builder must properly handle async generators without attempting to call send() method directly on them. It should correctly iterate through the async generator to extract values and handle control flow appropriately.

requirement.description: The seq builder is encountering an AttributeError with 'list_iterator' object has no attribute 'send', indicating similar issues with iterator handling in async contexts.
requirement.contract: The seq builder must properly handle iterators without attempting to call send() method on them. It should correctly process sequence generators and maintain proper iteration semantics.
